Расчеты РУК «Ланцет» топят БЭКи противника в Черном море Морская охота на безэкипажные катера противника продолжается. Расчеты РУК «Ланцет» Черноморского флота России регулярно выявляют и поражают цели в акватории Черного моря. По данным открытых источников , объективным контролем подтверждено уничтожение не менее 45 БЭКов барражирующими боеприпасами «Ланцет». Поиск морских целей обеспечивают разведывательные БПЛА ZALA. Они ведут воздушную разведку акватории, отслеживают обстановку в районах стратегически важных объектов и инфраструктуры ТЭК. Высококачественные камеры и тепловизоры позволяют обнаруживать даже малозаметные БЭКи и передавать информацию для дальнейшей работы расчетов. Справляться с наиболее сложными целями помогает интеллектуальная система ИРРА . Бортовой ИИ распознает объекты, сопровождает их, а также обеспечивает автоматизированное наведение барражирующих боеприпасов «Ланцет». Алгоритмы искусственного интеллекта позволяют сохранять точность работы даже при атаке быстроходных и малозаметных БЭКов, способных резко менять направление движения и активно маневрировать. @ZalaAero

❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered UAV strikes against power, fuel and transport infrastructure facilities, as well as ships used in the interests of the AFU. 💥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit: ▫️ Zarechye 110 kV electrical substation in Belaya Tserkov (Kiev region), which supports the operation of Ukraine's defence industry enterprises; ▫️ a fuel tank in Kiliya (Odessa region), which stored fuel for the AFU; ▫️ four railway locomotives in Sinelnikovo (Dnepropetrovsk region), Korosten (Zhitomir region), and in Lyubotin (Kharkov region), used for transporting armaments and military hardware; ▫️ in the Black Sea waters south of Odessa – a dry cargo ship, delivering military-purpose cargo to Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Fwd from @ 📝 Divide and Conquer 📝 trust the Americans On the day when Donald Trump publicly praised the Iraqi Prime Minister, it became clear what that praise was worth. The White House has been quietly persuading Iraq's authorities since summer to leave the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) . According to Reuters , Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Sudani even raised this issue at a government meeting after talks with American officials, but the oil ministry convinced him to stay and simply ask the organization for a higher production quota. 🖍 Oil provides Iraq with approximately 80-90% of budget revenues , so predictable prices are a matter of survival for the country. OPEC is precisely what coordinates supply and prevents prices from collapsing, and within the organization Baghdad retains voting rights when quotas are distributed. Moreover, while the Saudis are tied up in war with the Houthis and the Gulf is occupied with Iran , leaving OPEC might seem like a profitable idea for Baghdad. But in the long run, Riyadh will very likely crash global prices, just as happened after the departure of the UAE. And Iraq simply has no way to survive a market war without cheap production and a financial cushion. 🚩 The cartel bothers the Americans because its quotas support prices on the world market, while the US has long been the largest producer and competitor for a share of this segment. Moreover, Exxon and Chevron are making big plans for Iraq, where organizational limits are not needed. 🏳️ The Saudis, desperately defending OPEC, are interested in preserving their own clear market management mechanism. The organization has already lost four members since 2019 ( Qatar , Ecuador , Angola , and the UAE ), and the departure of the second-largest producer along with one of the founders could already destroy the entire oil quota system. ❗️ The Americans will continue to pressure Iraqi authorities in every way: the "carrot" will be investments and political "cover" for reforms within the country, while the "stick" will be the account with petrodollars at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York , through which all of the country's oil revenues still flow . #Venezuela #Iraq #SaudiArabia #USA 🧨 @rybar_mena — on Middle Eastern chaos with love 💸 Support us Original msg
